name: Toast
description: A stacked toaster: notifications pile up with depth, fan out on hover or focus, auto-dismiss with pause-on-hover, swipe away sideways, and include success, error, and promise (loading → done) variants.
a11yNotes: Toasts render in a portal inside a labelled <section> whose list is an aria-live="polite" region, so new messages are announced; error toasts additionally use role="alert". Each toast is focusable, Escape dismisses the focused toast, and every toast has a labelled close button. Hovering or focusing the stack expands it and pauses auto-dismiss timers. Stacked-away toasts are aria-hidden and removed from the tab order. Reduced motion removes the spring stacking and slide animations.

propsApi.name: position
propsApi.description: Where the stack is pinned in the window.

propsApi.name: duration
propsApi.description: Auto-dismiss time in ms (0 keeps toasts until dismissed); paused while hovered or focused.

propsApi.name: actionLabel
propsApi.description: Action button on the default toast (empty hides it).

propsApi.name: promiseDelay
propsApi.description: Milliseconds before the promise toast resolves to success.

propsApi.name: maxVisible
propsApi.description: Toasts visible in the stack at once.

propsApi.name: gap
propsApi.description: Gap between toasts when expanded, in pixels.

propsApi.name: expand
propsApi.description: Keep the stack expanded instead of expanding on hover.

propsApi.name: closeButton
propsApi.description: Show a close button on each toast.

propsApi.name: swipeToDismiss
propsApi.description: Allow dismissing toasts by dragging them sideways.

propsApi.name: accentColor
propsApi.description: Spinner, focus ring, and accent color.
